_readme: Rules for scripts/scaligent-tokens/tally.mjs. Edit here when a decision changes, then re-run `npm run scaligent-tokens:tally`. Decisions: Scaligent names in code, Figma wins on values (docs/2026-10-06-dark-mode-rollout-plan.md section 9).
_nameMap: Scaligent name to the CSS variable we use today, where they differ. Phase 2 renames ours to the Scaligent name; remove the row when it does.
_aliases: Our older names for a token that also exists under the Scaligent name. Reported as proposed, with the canonical name.
_proposed: Radiant Play tokens Scaligent does not have. Same naming scheme, one line on why each exists.

proposed.background-inset: Gray/40 fill (light #C0C6CF) for recessed tracks and wells; Scaligent has no equivalent
proposed.background-raised-inverse: Raised surface on an inverse (dark in light mode) area
proposed.border-brand-inverse: Brand border on an inverse surface
proposed.border-default-inverse: Default border on an inverse surface
proposed.border-hover-inverse: Hover border on an inverse surface
proposed.content-alternate: Text on coloured fills (light #FFFFFF); overlaps content-inverse in light mode
proposed.content-brand-inverse: Brand text on an inverse surface
proposed.content-link: Link text, separate from content-brand so links can change without changing brand text
proposed.content-link-inverse: Link text on an inverse surface
proposed.content-link-inverse-hover: Hovered link text on an inverse surface

_figmaNameMap: Figma variable names (kebab-cased from the Theme collection) that differ from the Scaligent name. Used by --names. Figma wins on values only.
_figmaShadowParts: Figma stores each shadow as four variables (-1-blur, -1-color, -2-blur, -2-color). They all map to the one Scaligent shadow token.
